predictor_forecast_semantics: Direct H1-H5 forecasts from observed history through 2025, matching Step-27 validation. Forecast future values are subsequently used to reconstruct future temporal features.

feature_engineering.history_rule: lag/history features are based on prior predictor values

spatial_anomaly_centering: Subtract the mean raw anomaly prediction across all 2,194 grids separately in every future year.
final_equation: predicted grid LST = forecast annual Kaduwela thermal level + centered spatial anomaly
uncertainty_note: Step 28 is point forecasting. Formal calibrated forecast uncertainty is handled in the later uncertainty stage; predictor and annual-level forecast errors can compound.
interpretation_note: 2026-2030 results are model-based projections under the frozen historical forecasting assumptions, not observed future temperatures.
